parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the control panel of the printer.
parts.Functional_description: Used to power on/off or control printer functions such as start, stop, or cancel.
parts.Movement_description: Moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A hinged plastic lid covering the scanner or paper feed area.
parts.Functional_description: Protects internal components and provides access to the scanning or paper loading area.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: An external plastic component possibly part of the paper output tray or decorative cover.
parts.Functional_description: Guides printed paper or provides structural support.
parts.Movement_description: May slide or fold depending on design.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the printer made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: Houses all internal components including the print head, paper feed, and electronics.
parts.Movement_description: Stationary; serves as the structural foundation for all other parts.
